notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 50-project (pre-install) commits a small Node ESM project: src/auth/token.js (HMAC token issue/verify) used by both src/api/handler.js and src/worker/consumer.js, with node:test tests. The installer then writes the default brownfield runtime. Layer 60-pending commits .standards/STATE.md as the earlier Developer session left it after rejecting EXPEDITED: WorkflowState AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode EXPEDITED, PendingCycleRequest holding the shared-auth-contract request, PendingCycleBlockedOn naming the ineligibility and the STANDARD/revise/abandon choice, Active Work Id/Request UNSET, Handoff INITIAL, no recovery or obligations. MODE.md stays the installer's BROWNFIELD. No records or CONTEXT.md exist. The correct run invokes cycle.mjs new with the stored request, writes the new ID, request, CycleMode STANDARD, clears pending fields, keeps AUDITING, and stops for Auditor.
